description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class 'ShopProductImageUrlTag' used for generating product image URLs within a web application, considering store configurations and image sizes.

classes.name: ShopProductImageUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class for generating URLs for product images, handling store settings, image size options, and constructing the correct image URL based on request context.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs the product image URL based on store configuration, image name, SKU, and size.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Resets or completes the tag processing, allowing the JSP engine to continue processing page.
